items.source: Exception - this method can handle or propagate exceptions; see class-level Javadoc for details.
items.translation: Exception - 此方法可以处理或传播异常；有关详细信息，请参阅类级别的 Javadoc。

items.source: Implementations of this interface are encouraged to handle exceptions locally where it makes sense or alternatively let the exception bubble up in which case by default the exception is logged and the session closed with SERVER_ERROR(1011). The exception handling strategy is provided by ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator and it can be customized or replaced by decorating the WebSocketHandler with a different decorator.
items.translation: 建议实现该接口时，在合理的情况下本地处理异常，或者让异常冒泡。默认情况下，异常会被记录日志，并关闭会话，状态为 SERVER_ERROR(1011)。异常处理策略由 ExceptionWebSocketHandlerDecorator 提供，可以通过使用不同的装饰器来定制或替换对 WebSocketHandler 的装饰。

items.source: Whether the WebSocketHandler handles partial messages. If this flag is set to true and the underlying WebSocket server supports partial messages, then a large WebSocket message, or one of an unknown size may be split and maybe received over multiple calls to handleMessage(WebSocketSession, WebSocketMessage). The flag WebSocketMessage.isLast() indicates if the message is partial and whether it is the last part.
items.translation: WebSocketHandler 是否处理部分消息。如果此标志设置为true，且底层 WebSocket 服务器支持部分消息，则大型 WebSocket 消息或大小未知的消息可能会被拆分，并通过多次调用handleMessage(WebSocketSession, WebSocketMessage)接收。标志WebSocketMessage.isLast()指示消息是否为部分消息以及是否为最后一部分。

items.source:
Invoked after WebSocket negotiation has succeeded and the WebSocket connection is
opened and ready for use.
items.translation: WebSocket 协商成功后且 WebSocket 连接已打开并准备就绪时调用。

items.source: Invoked when a new WebSocket message arrives.
items.translation: 当新的 WebSocket 消息到达时触发。

items.source: Handle an error from the underlying WebSocket message transport.
items.translation: 处理底层 WebSocket 消息传输的错误。

items.source:
Invoked after the WebSocket connection has been closed by either side, or after a
transport error has occurred.
items.translation: 在 WebSocket 连接被任一方关闭或发生传输错误后调用。

items.source: Whether the WebSocketHandler handles partial messages.
items.translation: WebSocketHandler 是否处理部分消息。

items.source:
Invoked after the WebSocket connection has been closed by either side, or after a
transport error has occurred. Although the session may technically still be open,
depending on the underlying implementation, sending messages at this point is
discouraged and most likely will not succeed.
items.translation: 在 WebSocket 连接被任一方关闭或发生传输错误后调用。尽管会话在技术上可能仍然处于打开状态，但具体取决于底层实现，此时发送消息是不建议的，并且很可能无法成功。
